The '''Pleiades''' was a [[Constellation/Legends|constellation]].<ref name="Haynes website">{{WebCite|url=http://www.mhaynesart.com/PieceDetails.php?ID=170|text=Michael Haynes Art - Miscellaneous|work=[http://www.mhaynesart.com mhaynesart.com]|archiveurl=https://archive.is/r2sAa|nolive=1}}</ref> It contained [[Endymion]],<ref name="Visions" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Kalamith sector/Legends|Kalamith sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Atlas">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> that was the site of a [[Skirmish on Endymion|skirmish]] between [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] during a galaxy-wide war.<ref name="Visions" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Pleiades was fleetingly mentioned for the [[2010]] book ''[[Star Wars Art: Visions]]'' as the home for the planet Endymion in [[Michael Haynes]]'s artwork ''Skirmish on Endymion''.<ref name="Visions" /> According to Haynes' website, he originally meant for the Pleiades to be a [[Wikipedia:Constellation|constellation]],<ref name="Haynes website" /> although this information was ultimately absent from the final version of the book.<ref name="Visions" /> In real-life [[Wikipedia:Astronomy|astronomy]], the [[Wikipedia:Pleiades|Pleiades]] is an open [[Wikipedia:Star cluster|star cluster]] located in the constellation of [[Wikipedia:Taurus (constellation)|Taurus]].<ref name="SEDS">{{WebCite|url=http://www.messier.seds.org/m/m045.html|text=Messier Object 45|work=[http://www.messier.seds.org messier.seds.org]|archivedate=20171102144239}}</ref> A [[June 12]], [[2015]] update to the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Companion]] added an [[Endymion system/Legends|Endymion system]] in the Kalamith sector of the Outer Rim, though no mention of the Pleiades was made.<ref name="Atlas" />
